freshness.clock_scope: existing service source clock; assumes monotonic service millis; no independent clock comparison
freshness.gap_scope: pre-check/post-commit bounds clipped after previous post-commit observation; no head/tail extrapolation
freshness.post_commit_ttl_scope: observation age reaching TTL is not proof of accepting stale input at the original gate
freshness.snapshot_scope: recorder only; enclosing health caller may hold the shared service RLock
